foundations.title: Counting
foundations.description: Say number names in order and match each name to one object to find how many objects a set holds.

foundations.title: Addition
foundations.description: Combine two or more quantities into one total, from joining small sets of objects to multi-digit sums.

foundations.title: Subtraction
foundations.description: Find the difference between two quantities or how many remain after some are taken away.

foundations.title: Place value
foundations.description: Read the value of a digit from its position in a number, such as ones, tens, hundreds, and tenths.

foundations.title: Multiplication
foundations.description: Find the total of equal-sized groups, as repeated addition, arrays, and area models.

foundations.title: Division
foundations.description: Split a quantity into equal groups, or find how many equal groups a quantity holds.

foundations.title: Fractions
foundations.description: Represent parts of a whole or of a set as a numerator over a denominator, and compare and combine them.

foundations.title: Decimals
foundations.description: Write fractions with denominators of powers of ten in place-value notation, such as 0.25.

foundations.title: Percentages
foundations.description: Express a ratio as parts per hundred and use it to compare quantities or find part of a whole.

foundations.title: Perimeter
foundations.description: Find the total length of the boundary of a two-dimensional shape.

foundations.title: Area
foundations.description: Measure the amount of surface a two-dimensional shape covers, in square units.

foundations.title: Exponents
foundations.description: Write repeated multiplication of a base as a power, such as 2^3 = 8, and apply the rules of powers.

foundations.title: Linear equations
foundations.description: Write and solve equations in which each variable appears to the first power, such as 2x + 3 = 7.

foundations.title: Functions
foundations.description: Describe a rule that assigns exactly one output to each input, and read it as a table, graph, or formula.

foundations.title: Pythagorean theorem
foundations.description: In a right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides.

foundations.title: Atoms
foundations.description: The smallest units of a chemical element, made of a nucleus of protons and neutrons with electrons around it.

foundations.title: Cells
foundations.description: The basic structural and functional units of living organisms, bounded by a membrane.

foundations.title: Loops
foundations.description: Programming constructs, such as for and while, that repeat a block of code until a condition is met.
